about.title: About Hassan Khel
about.intro: Hassan Khel is a Pashtun village in the Charsadda district of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa, Pakistan. This directory is a community effort to record our families, honour our elders, and stay connected with those who have moved to the cities and abroad.
about.historyBody: A tight-knit community bound by lineage, the mosque, the hujra and the jirga. Many of our sons and brothers now work in Karachi, Dubai and Saudi Arabia, yet their roots remain here.
about.purposeBody: So that every family is recorded, every profession is known, and the next generation can trace where they come from.
about.contactBody: To correct a record, report a concern, or help maintain the directory, contact the village admin team.
about.privacyBody: Phone numbers and emails are never shown publicly. Anyone may ask to have a photo replaced with a neutral avatar, or a record hidden.

footer.tagline: Built by the community, for the community.
footer.privacyNote: No tracking. No ads. Phone & email always private.
footer.madeWith: Made with respect for our elders and our traditions.
